title: Mila Calcifer Interviews you

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Good day, welcome to the interview. Please take a seat.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good day, welcome to the interview. Please take a seat.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Excellent question. I'm glad to hear you are engaging in this process pro-actively and asking for more information.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Excellent question. I'm glad to hear you are engaging in this process pro-actively and asking for more information.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: You could also get married.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You could also get married.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Some of these questions will make you interrogate your deepest beliefs and values.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Some of these questions will make you interrogate your deepest beliefs and values.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: ... Please note that although there are no wrong answers this is nonetheless the wrong answer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ... Please note that although there are no wrong answers this is nonetheless the wrong answer.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: My father, Mr Gospodin, needs support, kindness and encouragement. His mood has been very low since he lost his... Since he experienced a bereavement.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My father, Mr Gospodin, needs support, kindness and encouragement. His mood has been very low since he lost his... Since he experienced a bereavement.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Let me just calculate your score so far. Perhaps you can tell from the sound of my voice that I am pleased with your choices up to this point.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let me just calculate your score so far. Perhaps you can tell from the sound of my voice that I am pleased with your choices up to this point.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: You defused an awkward situation and secured a second date. Good work!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You defused an awkward situation and secured a second date. Good work!

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Oh... really? You want to opt out? Neither me nor Mr Gospodin will contact you about this opportunity - or anything else - again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh... really? You want to opt out? Neither me nor Mr Gospodin will contact you about this opportunity - or anything else - again.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: That seems sensible, but I'm afraid you missed out on an opportunity to secure a second date with a high value companion.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That seems sensible, but I'm afraid you missed out on an opportunity to secure a second date with a high value companion.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: While this "tough love" approach may work for some people, I'm afraid this is a little TOO tough for me. And for Mr Gospodin.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: While this "tough love" approach may work for some people, I'm afraid this is a little TOO tough for me. And for Mr Gospodin.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: She implies Mr Gospodin is lazy. Though he laughs this off, you can tell it upsets him, but Janice, with her stupid smirk, is somehow his best friend. How do you deal with this situation?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She implies Mr Gospodin is lazy. Though he laughs this off, you can tell it upsets him, but Janice, with her stupid smirk, is somehow his best friend. How do you deal with this situation?

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Hmm, a "hands off" approach might not be the best in this situation. I'm noting your answer, but please notice the change in my demeanor, the position of my eyebrows, and the way I am typing in an agitated manner.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmm, a "hands off" approach might not be the best in this situation. I'm noting your answer, but please notice the change in my demeanor, the position of my eyebrows, and the way I am typing in an agitated manner.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: What a threatening and direct approach. You will note that the tone of my voice there was not one of disappointment or disapproval.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What a threatening and direct approach. You will note that the tone of my voice there was not one of disappointment or disapproval.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Yes, challenging bullies in such a direct way and making them justify their words is effective and I approve.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, challenging bullies in such a direct way and making them justify their words is effective and I approve.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Well done! I am pleased to announce you are through to the next round. Good work.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well done! I am pleased to announce you are through to the next round. Good work.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: I'm afraid you haven't quite met the required grade to continue on to the next stage of the interview.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm afraid you haven't quite met the required grade to continue on to the next stage of the interview.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: I... really thought you might do better. Well... thank you for your time. I guess I'll go see if Danny still wants to do the interview. Or... *sigh* Lucy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I... really thought you might do better. Well... thank you for your time. I guess I'll go see if Danny still wants to do the interview. Or... *sigh* Lucy.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Well friendship is also an option. You can become pals. Buds. Besties! Please, trust the process and talk with my father at your earliest possible convenience.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well friendship is also an option. You can become pals. Buds. Besties! Please, trust the process and talk with my father at your earliest possible convenience.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: I don't think so.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think so.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Are you sure you want to stop now, or do you want to learn more?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you sure you want to stop now, or do you want to learn more?

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: To offset any inconvenience, at the end you will be given a cookie.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: To offset any inconvenience, at the end you will be given a cookie.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: You're chickening out? Then you're not for my father.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're chickening out? Then you're not for my father.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: I have to! He's vulnerable!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have to! He's vulnerable!

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: I'm responsible for him!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm responsible for him!

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Then what should I do? This world is gonna eat him alive!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then what should I do? This world is gonna eat him alive!

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Don't leave him!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't leave him!

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Get out! You had your chance!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Get out! You had your chance!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Huh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Please don't delay. We have a lot of candidates to get through. This is a very popular position we're recruiting for today.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Please don't delay. We have a lot of candidates to get through. This is a very popular position we're recruiting for today.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Which position?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Which position?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is this a job interview?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is this a job interview?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is this about Garnet?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is this about Garnet?

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: In a way, yes. But this is more important than a job.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: In a way, yes. But this is more important than a job.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Yes, this is about my father.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, this is about my father.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Mr Gospodin - my father - currently has an opening available for the role of friend, partner, lover, smooch-buddy, acquaintance, bestie and/or sister-or-brother-from-another-mother.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mr Gospodin - my father - currently has an opening available for the role of friend, partner, lover, smooch-buddy, acquaintance, bestie and/or sister-or-brother-from-another-mother.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?!

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: That is an option if you meet our advanced recruitment criteria. Can I just check, at this time, are you interested in ANY of these positions?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That is an option if you meet our advanced recruitment criteria. Can I just check, at this time, are you interested in ANY of these positions?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This isn't for me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This isn't for me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right...

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: I will ask a series of questions to build up a social, interpersonal, emotional and romantic profile of who you are as a person. Please answer truthfully at all times.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I will ask a series of questions to build up a social, interpersonal, emotional and romantic profile of who you are as a person. Please answer truthfully at all times.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ...Ok

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...Ok

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Please save your own questions for the end. Now, here is your first scenario task... You are eating dinner with Mr Gospodin.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Please save your own questions for the end. Now, here is your first scenario task... You are eating dinner with Mr Gospodin.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, I don't really mind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, I don't really mind.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll pay. It's only spaghetti. And he can pay for the next one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll pay. It's only spaghetti. And he can pay for the next one.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll pay. It's only spaghetti. And he can pay for the next one.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll pay. It's only spaghetti. And he can pay for the next one.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wait... what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait... what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes, that's pretty gross.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, that's pretty gross.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Yes, precisely. Now your meal together is coming to an end. Mr Gospodin reveals he has left his wallet at home, and his Comm is broken - again - because every time I tell him he needs a new one, he says "But I don't like how heavy the new Comms are..."

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, precisely. Now your meal together is coming to an end. Mr Gospodin reveals he has left his wallet at home, and his Comm is broken - again - because every time I tell him he needs a new one, he says "But I don't like how heavy the new Comms are..."

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I pay for us, but ask him to transfer the Lims as soon as he gets home

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I pay for us, but ask him to transfer the Lims as soon as he gets home
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I pay for us, but ask him to transfer the Lims as soon as he gets home
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I pay for us, but ask him to transfer the Lims as soon as he gets home

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So... keep him in line?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So... keep him in line?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ...Where?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...Where?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ...Maybe?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...Maybe?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, I'm out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, I'm out.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ...Sure. Tell me more.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...Sure. Tell me more.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What kind of cookie?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What kind of cookie?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So... clean him up a bit?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So... clean him up a bit?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So... clean him up a bit?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So... clean him up a bit?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I pay for my half. He can figure out the rest.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I pay for my half. He can figure out the rest.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I pay for my half. He can figure out the rest.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I pay for my half. He can figure out the rest.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ok.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Time for your third question, and the last for today. I hope you're finding this process rewarding.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Time for your third question, and the last for today. I hope you're finding this process rewarding.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Only one more question - for this round anyway. Let's push through.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Only one more question - for this round anyway. Let's push through.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This round?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This round?

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Yes indeed. We have many candidates to get through, and several rounds of evaluations and questionnaires, so let's keep moving.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes indeed. We have many candidates to get through, and several rounds of evaluations and questionnaires, so let's keep moving.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Let's keep going.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let's keep going.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Janice is Garnet's friend, not mine. It's not my place to get involved, and making a scene might cause more embarrassment.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Janice is Garnet's friend, not mine. It's not my place to get involved, and making a scene might cause more embarrassment.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Janice is Garnet's friend, not mine. It's not my place to get involved, and making a scene might cause more embarrassment.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Janice is Garnet's friend, not mine. It's not my place to get involved, and making a scene might cause more embarrassment.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm still not sure about this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm still not sure about this.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm still not sure about this.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm still not sure about this.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I would very clearly ask her to repeat the joke and explain why it is funny. Bullies don't like it when you ask them to justify themselves.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I would very clearly ask her to repeat the joke and explain why it is funny. Bullies don't like it when you ask them to justify themselves.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I would very clearly ask her to repeat the joke and explain why it is funny. Bullies don't like it when you ask them to justify themselves.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I would very clearly ask her to repeat the joke and explain why it is funny. Bullies don't like it when you ask them to justify themselves.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I would play it cool... but later I would confront Janice in private and make it clear that if she ever hurt Garnet again, I would feed her into a sustenance recombinator.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I would play it cool... but later I would confront Janice in private and make it clear that if she ever hurt Garnet again, I would feed her into a sustenance recombinator.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I would play it cool... but later I would confront Janice in private and make it clear that if she ever hurt Garnet again, I would feed her into a sustenance recombinator.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I would play it cool... but later I would confront Janice in private and make it clear that if she ever hurt Garnet again, I would feed her into a sustenance recombinator.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is that the end of the quiz?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is that the end of the quiz?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Is that the end of the quiz?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Is that the end of the quiz?

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Yes indeed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes indeed.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So... how did I do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So... how did I do?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Oh that's a shame.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh that's a shame.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Whatever.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Uh... bye.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Uh... bye.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ...Really?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...Really?

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: Yes indeed. You have done quite well.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes indeed. You have done quite well.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Uh... what now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Uh... what now?

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: I will be in contact. Meanwhile, please seek out Mr Gospodin. My research suggests more interactions can foster more intimate relationships.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I will be in contact. Meanwhile, please seek out Mr Gospodin. My research suggests more interactions can foster more intimate relationships.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not sure I want that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure I want that.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not sure I want that.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not sure I want that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Alright.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Isn't that a bit quick?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Isn't that a bit quick?

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: This interview is for you to learn about us as much as it is for us to learn about you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This interview is for you to learn about us as much as it is for us to learn about you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're kidding me, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're kidding me, right?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is this treatable?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is this treatable?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're insane, girl. I'm out!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're insane, girl. I'm out!

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: And this process may make you reevaluate your ethics, how you deal with others, and even your fundamental understanding of who you are as a person.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And this process may make you reevaluate your ethics, how you deal with others, and even your fundamental understanding of who you are as a person.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: He is eating spaghetti. He has sauce on his chin. Not a small amount. Half a meatball is stuck on there. Do you tell him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He is eating spaghetti. He has sauce on his chin. Not a small amount. Half a meatball is stuck on there. Do you tell him?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I get it, you want to protect him from whatever.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I get it, you want to protect him from whatever.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I get it, you want to protect him from whatever.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I get it, you want to protect him from whatever.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He's also an adult!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He's also an adult!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes, he is. But he's already wounded.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, he is. But he's already wounded.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yes, he is. But he's already wounded.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yes, he is. But he's already wounded.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, you're not.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, you're not.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He needs your love, not your protection!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He needs your love, not your protection!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He needs your love, not your protection!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He needs your love, not your protection!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll talk to him. Without your permission!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll talk to him. Without your permission!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll talk to him. Without your permission!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll talk to him. Without your permission!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just don't lock him away like you did from me!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just don't lock him away like you did from me!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Just don't lock him away like you did from me!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Just don't lock him away like you did from me!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He'll find someone else. Don't spoil it again!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He'll find someone else. Don't spoil it again!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He'll find someone else. Don't spoil it again!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He'll find someone else. Don't spoil it again!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Okay, it was funny in the beginning, but the joke is getting old.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Okay, it was funny in the beginning, but the joke is getting old.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Okay, it was funny in the beginning, but the joke is getting old.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Okay, it was funny in the beginning, but the joke is getting old.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: However, he also needs someone who is honest and clear with him, and will help him through clear communication, and positive feedback.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: However, he also needs someone who is honest and clear with him, and will help him through clear communication, and positive feedback.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I need to go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need to go.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I really need to leave.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I really need to leave.

nodes.speaker: Mila Kalcifer
nodes.text: You are out with Mr Gospodin and some of his friends. One of them, "Janice", makes a joke about his threadbare sweater and low income.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You are out with Mr Gospodin and some of his friends. One of them, "Janice", makes a joke about his threadbare sweater and low income.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is this finally over?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is this finally over?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're a funny young woman. I really like you! Your father will be happy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're a funny young woman. I really like you! Your father will be happy.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're a funny young woman. I really like you! Your father will be happy.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're a funny young woman. I really like you! Your father will be happy.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Listen, Mila. You're a great daughter to your father.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Listen, Mila. You're a great daughter to your father.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Listen, Mila. You're a great daughter to your father.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Listen, Mila. You're a great daughter to your father.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're as brave as it gets. But this here doesn't help him!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're as brave as it gets. But this here doesn't help him!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're as brave as it gets. But this here doesn't help him!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're as brave as it gets. But this here doesn't help him!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Great.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Great.

effects.label: End quest: Garnet. Single Dad. Seeks Love.
